views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates described Redox as a distributor of chemical products across Australasia with a smaller US business, noting it listed a little over 12 months ago.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said Redox had a very long operating track record and impressive numbers, citing average revenue growth of 12% over 30 years and 11% over 10 years, while questioning whether that growth rate could continue.
